newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS -- Issues to watch -- Feb 11.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS -- Issues to watch -- Feb 11.

text.p: * Shares of 3Com Corp stood at 37-5/16 in after-hours trading Monday after losing 13-1/2 points during the regular session to close at 37-1/4.
* Other high techs did better overnight in London. International Business Machines Corp was up 1/2 at 143-1/4 while Intel Corp gained 7/8 to 152-1/2 and Digital Equipment Corp rose 1/4 to 34-1/2.
* Tobacco shares were lower in London on worries about litigation. Philip Morris Cos Inc fell 3/8 to 119-7/8 and RJR Nabisco Holdings Corp fell 1/8 to 33-7/8.
* CIGNA Corp is expected to report fourth quarter earnings per share of $3.44, compared to $3.62 a year ago, according to First Call. The stock closed at 157-1/8.
* Equitable Cos Inc is expected to report fourth quarter earnings per share of $0.52, compared to $0.49 a year ago, according to First Call. Shares closed at 29-1/4.
* Aon Corp is expected to report fourth quarter earnings per share of $0.71, compared to $0.80 a year ago, according to First Call. Shares closed at 63-7/8.
* VF Corp is expected to announce a restructuring effort Tuesday that would cut 2,000 to 3,000 jobs over four years, the Wall Street Journal said. Shares closed at 68.
